description: Delete a page on a DAO's company-layer wiki, with its whole history and its Talk room. Holders only, the same gate as save_wiki_page. Nothing restores it, so read it first with get_page if it may be wanted. Requires the Bearer token from the `login` tool, sent as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on the POST carrying this call.

daoId.description: cashtag of the DAO whose wiki page to delete

name: delete_wiki_page
title: Delete a DAO wiki page
